exceptions.reason: Platform adapter for the sound/mp3 asset type on the SWF-library path. Flash embedded an MP3 as a class extending Sound and decoded it in the VM; nothing constructs a Sound on HTML5, so the frames SwfSound extracts are handed to one explicitly and lazily. The component-library path reaches Sound through ComponentLibraryEmbedFactory instead, which is where the missing sound support was actually crashing playSound.
exceptions.state: hand-written port -- must become converter output
